_comment: Curated notes per run, read by catalog.py. Every statement comes from docs/AGENT_LOG.md (time in brackets = log entry, laptop clock EST) or from the run's own files; nothing here is inferred from looking at pictures. Flags: ok = usable as logged · partial = usable except the items in exclude.json / named in the note · caution = review the images before using · exclude = do not train from it · probe = grasp or diagnostic test, not dataset · live = sort run (evidence about the loop; no ground-truth labels in the data) · empty = nothing captured. [claude-code/claude-fable-5-2 · op Ali · Alis-MacBook-Air · ali/pipeline · 2026-11-13 evening]
